one_line_description: Open-source backend-as-a-service with Postgres database and APIs
auth_methods_evidence: Supabase also has a Management API to help with managing your Supabase Platform, and a CLI for local development and CI workflows.
self_serve_evidence: The Supabase client libraries help you interact with Supabase products, such as the Postgres Database, Auth, and Realtime. They are available in several popular programming languages.
buildability_rationale: Self-serve with free tier, broad API coverage, multiple auth methods, and Composio support.
agent_notes: Supabase provides a comprehensive set of client libraries for multiple programming languages and has a Management API for platform management.
